speaker: Luis Xtravaganza Camacho
context: A Sound Factory weekend that never ended: from the Factory at dawn to Richard Vasquez's after-hours club the Choice at noon, then back again
quote: There was a night where me and David Ian were at the Sound Factory. We didn't get to the Sound Factory till like five, six in the morning, right? And so, you know, 12 in the afternoon, we jump in a cab, we go to the Choice.
